about.title: About
about.description_1: I design and deliver scalable web applications with a strong focus on architecture, maintainability, and engineering standards. I have led frontend development from the ground up using React.js and actively contributed to backend systems built with Laravel and Node.js.
about.description_2: My approach goes beyond feature implementation. I focus on building structured systems: defining modular architectures, applying
about.description_3: principles, and enforcing clean code practices to ensure long-term scalability. I have experience standardizing Git workflows, implementing semantic versioning strategies, and managing monorepos with controlled release processes to create predictable and secure production environments.
about.description_4: I thrive in collaborative, agile teams where technical decisions matter. My objective is to contribute not only through development, but by strengthening code quality, delivery processes, and overall system reliability.

movilbox.title: Movilbox
movilbox.subtitle: Software Developer
description: Led the end-to-end frontend development from the ground up using React.js, establishing a modular architecture, scalable project structure, and long-term technical standards to support product growth.
Contributed strategically to backend development in Laravel (PHP), designing and optimizing RESTful APIs to ensure performance, maintainability, and seamless frontend-backend integration.
Architected and implemented a monorepo strategy with Lerna, enabling scalable multi-module development, improving cross-project code reuse, and reducing maintenance overhead.
Defined and enforced a structured Git branching strategy, enhancing team collaboration, minimizing integration conflicts, and improving delivery predictability.
Established a structured release and versioning workflow using Lerna and Git tags, ensuring production traceability, controlled rollouts, and reliable version governance.
Standardized commit conventions under Conventional Commits, strengthening semantic versioning practices and improving repository clarity and long-term maintainability.
Designed a controlled patch-based production deployment process, reducing release risk and increasing operational stability across delivery cycles.
